mutations.contract_domain: Cursor construction admits only positive default and maximum sizes, without a stable plain configuration-error message promise.
mutations.reason: Changing MaxSize <= 0 to MaxSize < 0 differs only at zero maximum: the already-positive DefaultSize then exceeds MaxSize and the next guard still refuses before construction or callbacks. Only unpromised plain diagnostic wording differs. Independently re-reviewed 2026-10-14 by /root/audit_b against current source and the pinned release verifier; owner library maintainer. Expires on changed constructor guards, public error contract, production-source identity, or verifier/operator semantics. Native LIVED remains visible.

mutations.contract_domain: Direct cursor admission returns the same fixed refusal before allocation, callbacks, sorting or partial requests when encoded-sort budgets are insufficient.
mutations.reason: Changing prefix > sortRemaining OR prefix > bytesRemaining to AND delays refusal when just one budget is insufficient. Prefix is at most two and admitted preceding budgets are nonnegative; side-effect-free bounded subtraction makes that budget negative, so the next nonnegative name-length comparison returns the identical fixed refusal without overflow, allocation or external effects. Independently re-reviewed 2026-10-14 by /root/audit_b against current source and the pinned release verifier; owner library maintainer.
